svg.title: hLSTM block — restored grey paper-style schematic
svg.desc: Bottom-up single-head parallel hybrid block as implemented. A shared normalized projection is split into scalar and matrix channel shares. The scalar branch passes a causal depthwise Conv4 and SiLU to all four dense gate projections. The matrix branch has no convolution and has an external SiLU output gate from its own channel share. Separate branch LayerNorms and learned scalar scales precede channelwise convex fusion. The fusion gate is an affine sigmoid of the normalized input, tapped before the shared projection. Output projection, two residuals and the enabled SwiGLU complete the block.
